exports.n: Customs data record 34.5 Mt of wheat exports from Russia in 2024 (CEPII BACI), of which 11.6 Mt is an Atlas estimate (the tonnage computed by the atlas from the declared value where the declared tonnage was implausible: Egypt 11.1 Mt, Nigeria 0.55 Mt) and 22.9 Mt is as reported; USDA PSD gives 55.5 Mt for 2023/24 and 43 Mt for 2024/25. These flows may rest on importers' declarations alone, so that destinations which do not report are missing; this is not established here. The published customs figure is 38% below the first and 20% below the second. On the tonnage as reported alone (22.9 Mt) the gap is 59% below the first and 47% below the second. Importers that took wheat from Russia in 2019 to 2021 and have none recorded in 2024: Bangladesh (1.75 Mt a year on average), Iran (1.24 Mt a year on average), Sudan (1 Mt a year on average), Yemen (0.93 Mt a year on average), DR Congo (0.548 Mt a year on average); the flows and lanes to them are zero in 2024.
